findings.claim: to_dict() uses asdict(), which leaves queued as a datetime object. Serializing the dict to JSON as task kwargs can raise TypeError.

verifier.reason: While AssignmentSource.to_dict() leaves queued as a datetime object (src/sentry/integrations/services/assignment_source.py:18,27-28), Sentry configures Celery to use pickle rather than JSON serialization (src/sentry/conf/server.py:739-741), and neither sync_assignee_outbound (src/sentry/integrations/tasks/sync_assignee_outbound.py:15-21) nor its apply_async call (src/sentry/integrations/utils/sync.py:136-145) overrides the serializer to JSON. Both pickle and Sentry's holds_bad_pickle_object check (src/sentry/celery.py:28-55) allow datetime values, so passing to_dict() as task kwargs does not raise TypeError.

findings.claim: Both parameters (attribute, sync_source) of the default should_sync implementation are unused and flagged by Ruff.

verifier.reason: While both `attribute` and `sync_source` are unused in the default `IssueBasicIntegration.should_sync` stub (`src/sentry/integrations/mixins/issues.py:66-67`), this repository does not use or configure Ruff at all (`.pre-commit-config.yaml:22-50` and `requirements-dev.txt:21-26` use `flake8` instead, and there is no Ruff config in `pyproject.toml`). Moreover, neither Ruff's default rules nor this repo's `flake8` configuration (`setup.cfg:95-103`) flags unused method parameters.
